description: Lantanor wears a long deep plum-brown noble coat with subtle all-over textile motifs and narrow gold woven borders around the split collar, front edges, cuffs and hem. Small bronze clasps fasten the upper coat. An ivory linen tunic underneath has decorated neckline and lower border. A broad ornate brown leather belt has circular and square bronze fittings and long hanging ends. Dark trousers tuck into tall brown leather boots. Both hands and feet are fully visible. The outfit is opaque and tailored with no headgear, armor or weapon.
